prompt:
Extract ALL references to components from this document.

COMPONENTS: gui, cli, logic, globals, model, preferences


Include a reference when the sentence refers to the component by name, alias, or as a participant in a described interaction. Exclude when the name appears only inside a code-level path — even if the compound identifier is semantically related to the component — or as ordinary English with no architectural intent. Favor inclusion.

DOCUMENT:
S1: We have been successfully transitioning from a spaghetti to a more structured architecture with the model in the center, and the logic as an intermediate layer towards the gui which is the outer shell.
S2: There are additional utility packages for preferences and the cli.
S3: The dependencies are only directed towards the center.
S4: We have JUnit tests to detect violations of the most crucial dependencies (between logic, model, and gui), and the build will fail automatically in these cases.
S5: The model represents the most important data structures (BibDatases, BibEntries, Events, and related aspects) and has only a little bit of logic attached.
S6: The logic is responsible for reading/writing/importing/exporting and manipulating the model, and it is structured often as an API the gui can call and use.
S7: Only the gui knows the user and his preferences and can interact with him to help him solve tasks.
S8: For each layer, we form packages according to their responsibility, i.e., vertical structuring.
S9: The model should have no dependencies to other classes of JabRef and the logic should only depend on model classes.
S10: The cli package bundles classes that are responsible for JabRef’s command line interface.
S11: The preferences represents all information customizable by a user for her personal needs.
S12: We use an event bus to publish events from the model to the other layers.
S13: This allows us to keep the architecture but still react upon changes within the core in the outer layers.

Return JSON:
{"references": [{"sentence": N_INTEGER, "component": "Name", "matched_text": "text found in sentence"}]}
